definitions.explanation: A weapon designed to explode and cause damage. Can refer to various types of explosive devices.
Figuratively, something shocking or sensational, especially news or information.

examples.japanese: {爆弾|ばくだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{不発弾|ふはつだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{爆弾|ばくだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爆弾|ばくだん}⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧だった。

notes:
An explosive device, or figuratively, something shocking or sensational.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆弾|ばくだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to drop a bomb
- {爆弾|ばくだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕掛|しか}ける→仕掛ける：04243_shikakeru⟧: to plant a bomb
- {爆弾|ばくだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a bomb explodes
- {不発弾|ふはつだん}: unexploded bomb/dud

TYPES:
- ⟦{時限|じげん}→時限：13098_jigen⟧{爆弾|ばくだん}: time bomb
- {原子|げんし}{爆弾|ばくだん}: atomic bomb (often shortened to ⟦{原爆|げんばく}→原爆：11942_genbaku⟧)
- ⟦{水素|すいそ}→水素：00387_suiso⟧{爆弾|ばくだん}: hydrogen bomb (often shortened to {水爆|すいばく})

USAGE:
- {爆弾|ばくだん}⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧: bombshell statement
- {爆弾|ばくだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to drop a bombshell (figurative)

The figurative usage is common in news and everyday speech to describe shocking revelations.
